## Summary

Installs a canonical governance doctrine for Claude Code (and aligned with Codex via `AGENTS.md`) when doing repo-changing work in this project:

- **new**: `.claude/modules/shared/governance-principles.md` — canonical doctrine (truth over fluency, inspect before editing, minimal correct change, deterministic systems first, contract-sensitive surfaces, validation policy with `PASS / FAIL / NOT_RUN` buckets, confidence states, required final response structure). The `Canonical Writer Rules` and `Contract-Sensitive Surfaces` sections are tailored to dopemux-mvp's actual authorities (ConPort, dopetask, dopecon-bridge, Repo Truth Extractor, etc., per AGENTS §6).
- **edit**: `.claude/CLAUDE.md` — adds a `🎯 Governance Principles` section near the top + module link; one line in `📚 Detailed Information Locations`.
- **edit**: `AGENTS.md` — appends `§10 Claude-Code Doctrine Alignment` reciprocal cross-reference. PAL workflow chains remain owned by `§5` and are referenced (not duplicated) from the new module.

No code or runtime changes — documentation only.

## Test plan

- [ ] Read `.claude/modules/shared/governance-principles.md` — content reflects dopemux-mvp's actual canonical writers per AGENTS §6
- [ ] Confirm cross-references resolve: `.claude/CLAUDE.md` → module + `AGENTS.md §2 / §5`; module → `AGENTS.md §2 / §5 / §6 / §8`
- [ ] Verify `git diff main...HEAD --stat` shows only the three governance files

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
